import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long v;
    static long[] digits = new long[17];

    static int compute(int index, long value) {
        value = Math.abs(value);
        if (index == 0) {
            return (int) value;
        }
        int q1 = (int) (value / digits[index]);
        int q2 = q1 + 1;
        int cost1 = q1 * (index + 1) + compute(index - 1, value - q1 * digits[index]);
        int cost2 = q2 * (index + 1) + compute(index - 1, value - q2 * digits[index]);
        return Math.min(cost1, cost2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        v = sc.nextLong();
        digits[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            digits[i] = digits[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        System.out.println(compute(16, v));
        sc.close();
    }
}
